statement: Homeowners rely on half-baked spreadsheets or complex financial software that fails to streamline renovation budgeting and contractor tracking.
normalized_problem: Inadequate and fragmented tools for tracking renovation budgets and expenses
desired_outcome: Easily log contractor estimates, actual payments, materials, and schedules in one centralized tracker.
current_solutions: Custom or free downloaded Excel/Google Sheets budget templates
Dedicated renovation management apps (e.g., HomeZada, Home Stories)
attempts: Setting up custom spreadsheets with categories, estimates, and actuals
Configuring general financial software for home project tracking
solution_complaints: Traditional spreadsheets become fragmented and messy over multi-stage projects
General personal finance software like Quicken is unintuitive for tracking multi-item project budgets
path: Homeowners rely on half-baked spreadsheets or complex financial software that fails to streamline renovation budgeting and contractor tracking.
